oros@bigbrain ~ $ neofetch ▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄ oros@bigbrain ██▌▐██ ───────────── ▄▄▄▄██████▄▄▄▄ uptime 11 months on github ██████████████ repos 4 public · 2 stars ▄▄▄▄██████████████▄▄▄▄ langs ts · js · python · kotlin · c++ · gdscript ██████████████████████ stack react · node · postgres · fastapi · office.js ▄▄▄▄██████████████████████▄▄▄▄ tools blender · godot · yolov8 · whisper · ollama ██████████████████████████████ focus legal ai · local llms · speech · vision pair claude code phone galaxy s22+, running an llm on its npu
oros@bigbrain ~ $ cat ~/now shipping LawAngel: an AI legal assistant inside Microsoft Word (in beta) building LawHero: a CRM for law firms, from AI intake to invoices planning LawGuru: one portal that ties them together hacking LLMs on a phone NPU that the official tools gave up on
oros@bigbrain ~ $ tree ~/projects ~/projects ├── legal-tech │ ├── lawangel/ AI for lawyers inside Microsoft Word (in beta) │ ├── lawhero/ CRM for law firms: AI intake, client portal, billing │ ├── lawguru/ the portal that will tie them together │ ├── etemenanki-word/ the first Word add-in: AI contract review, no server needed │ ├── ophanim/ legal document management (Next.js, Express, Prisma) │ ├── ophanim-pipeline/ legal PDFs into AI training data, 14 workers + review app │ ├── taggingpro/ tags legal PDFs with self-hosted LLMs on rented GPUs │ ├── atlas/ plain-language search over case law (Qdrant, voyage-law-2) │ ├── atlas-meeting/ live meeting transcripts with an AI case summary │ ├── navi/ legal-document search: word index and tag filters │ ├── court-tools/ read-only API tools for two court case-file systems │ ├── scrapers/ case law, acts and regulations, scraped into one database │ ├── detectors/ YOLOv8: missing signatures and court stamps in PDFs │ ├── claude-ocr/ scans, stamps and handwriting to text with vision models │ └── geneva-api/ one FastAPI for law search, court files and meetings ├── ai │ ├── s22-npu-chat/ an LLM on the Galaxy S22+'s NPU, no internet needed │ ├── flychat/ a VRChat avatar steered by a simulated fruit-fly brain │ ├── qwen-legal-lora/ Qwen2.5 14B fine-tuned with LoRA on legal documents │ ├── whisper-tools/ transcripts with speaker labels, on a GTX 1650 │ ├── voice-assistant/ a local voice assistant on Ollama │ └── legalrag/ local RAG with sentence-transformers and Chroma ├── solar-car │ ├── tritium-archive/ legacy Tritium motor controller, BMS and CAN tools │ ├── race-tracker/ every team's live position and speed, per race day │ ├── energy-optimiser/ race energy strategy from the route (an IEEE method) │ └── pack-predictor/ battery voltage from telemetry, BMS logs and elevation ├── web-and-tools │ ├── 9AnimeToSimkl/ marks what you watch on 9animetv.to as watched on Simkl │ ├── k53-smart-test/ learner's-licence mock test that drills your weak spots │ ├── shelter-records/ an animal shelter's old Delphi app, rebuilt for the web │ └── pdf2indesign-gui/ GUI and one-file .exe for a PDF-to-InDesign converter └── 3d-and-games ├── jacaranda/ an indie game in Godot ├── lucy/ a VRChat companion avatar, sculpted and painted in Blender ├── slimevr-trackers/ DIY full-body VR trackers: ESP boards and IMUs ├── mineoros/ Minecraft seed finder in C++, built on cubiomes └── lawguru-brand/ logo animations for the LawGuru family
5 groups, 34 projects · gold ones are public on github
oros@bigbrain ~ $ cat ~/lab/notes - whisper on a GTX 1650: 55 min of audio in 4.2 min, speakers labelled from 3 s voice prints (fp16 gives garbage on 16-series cards; int8_float32 works) - follow-up questions rewritten before the law search: nDCG@10 0.27 → 0.82 - LawHero's production review: 77 AI agents, 49 findings, every one fixed - Kimi-Linear 48B on an 8 GB phone: about one token a second - fly-brain kernel: 748 → 100 ms a frame on a 4-core PC, with VRChat running - the fly avatar learned fear: it avoids a scary scene 40% of the time, others 0%
